sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. APPA and MAPD were already live on the clean data baseline, so the main agent pivoted within the same table to arXiv:2607.24343v1.

Deep read extracted aggregate-budget failure, alpha times p_r budget shrinkage, per-role CRC thresholding, rare-role pooling, AgentDojo/InjecAgent setup, shifted-condition compliance, and recorded-trace limitations.
Related-work check connected the paper to AgentDojo, InjecAgent, CaMeL, FIDES, PACT, CORA, information-flow control, and action-level conformal risk control.

Article flags limits around exchangeability, frozen distribution shift, detector-relative guarantees, role-label governance, shared-detector comparisons, and missing live replanning utility after blocks.
